description: Current FanDuel player prop lines and prices. Use it to answer "what is the line for <player> <stat>?" or to scan a game or league board. Each prop has line, over and under prices in American and decimal odds, status, and a move summary from open. Filter by player, stat, sport, league or event_id.

event_id.description: One game's event_id from list_events. Without it, games from 6 hours ago onward are searched.

league.description: League code, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, NCAAB, NCAAF.

offset.description: For the next page when has_more is true.

player.description: Player name or part of it, case-blind, for example "Adebayo". A part that fits several players returns them, with teams, instead of mixing their lines.

sport.description: Sport, lower case, for example basketball, football, hockey, baseball.

stat.description: Stat market, lower case: points, rebounds, assists, threes, pra and the other markets FanDuel lists.

team.description: Team abbreviation, for example MIA. Picks one of two players who share a name.

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 time: only props whose line, price or status changed after it.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Saved so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: list_props
